label: Colorado: enforcement and cure
note: Editorial summary of the cited primary provisions, not a verbatim extract. Current-law check as of September 22, 2026; enforcement cure procedures do not postpone substantive compliance duties.
body: The Attorney General and district attorneys enforce the Colorado Privacy Act. The general cure provision was repealed effective January 1, 2025.

A narrower current provision covers enforcement of the minors sections 6-1-1305.5, 6-1-1308.5 and 6-1-1309.5. If a cure is deemed possible, the enforcer must notify the controller before bringing the action; failure to cure within 60 days after receipt permits enforcement.
That minors-specific cure subsection is repealed effective December 31, 2026. It does not provide a general 60-day cure right for other CPA duties.
